title: Leveraging Critical Proof Obligations for Efficient IC3 Verification
problem: IC3 model-checking methods spend significant effort tracking proof obligations (states to prove unreachable), creating a bottleneck in hardware verification performance due to inefficient proof obligation management.
motivation: Hardware verification is a critical verification bottleneck; improving IC3's proof obligation handling directly reduces verification time for complex designs.
method: The technique identifies proof obligations (states that need to be proven unreachable) and ranks them by how severely they block verification progress. It focuses computational effort on the critical cases—the ones most preventing completion. For each critical state, it extracts the minimal set of constraints (logical rules restricting which states are possible) that prove it can't reach unsafe behavior, avoiding unnecessary reasoning. It also propagates proven safety properties systematically across related states, speeding up discovery of new verified layers (frames) and reusable proof facts (lemmas).
key_novelty: It prioritizes proof obligations by how severely they impede verification progress, using this ranking to guide the extraction of minimal constraint sets and propagation of proven safety facts across verification layers (frames).
contributions: Critical Proof Obligations framework to identify high-impact proof states
CPO-Driven Proof Obligation Propagation for faster frame refinement
Significant performance improvements on HWMCC benchmarks
